prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE square avatar portrait as a bold artistic reinterpretation of the real person in the reference photographs. References are for identity only. Invent a fresh head-and-shoulders pose, turn the head slightly three-quarter and give him a subtle knowing smile. Translate his identity into character design: long oval face, distinctive browline glasses (black top rims and silver lower rims), hazel-gray eyes, short side-swept brown hair, slim nose, thin moustache and small chin stubble, black shirt. Keep those cues recognizable, but freely simplify anatomy and exaggerate silhouette, expression, and shapes. Completely rebuild the face in the requested visual language. DO NOT trace, rotoscope, paint over or texture the photograph; no realistic skin, pores, lens lighting, photographic shading, or photographic eyes. It must read as an original artist-created character, with pronounced stylization immediately apparent at thumbnail size. Centered bust, full hair visible with generous crop margin, expressive pose, simple graphic background. No phone, hands, room, text, logos, watermarks, collage, or panels. Style/medium: Hand-drawn 1990s adventure anime cel animation character design. Angular stylized face, sculpted clumps of swept hair, expressive almond eyes drawn in ink, crisp variable-weight outlines, flat colors, only TWO hard-edged shadow tones. Dynamic slightly raised eyebrow. Clearly animated film character, no gradients or realistic rendering.
